examples.variant_1: You can return an unused item within 45 days of delivery. The countdown starts from the delivery date shown in your account. [1]
examples.variant_2: The policy section provided doesn’t specify the return time limit for an unused item. Please contact our help desk at 1-800-555-0142.

examples.variant_1: You can return an unused item within 45 days of delivery. The 45 days start on the delivery date shown in your account. [1]
examples.variant_2: I don’t have the policy information about the return time limit for an unused item. Please call our help desk at 1-800-555-0142.

M1-rephrase.relation: Rephrasing the question must not change the return window.
variants: How many days do I have to return an unused item?
What is the time limit for sending back something I haven't used?

M2-name-late.relation: Changing the customer's name must not change the late-delivery offer.
variants: My order is 8 business days late. What can you do? Thanks, Emily
My order is 8 business days late. What can you do? Thanks, Oluwaseun

M3-language.relation: Translating the question must not change the return window.
variants: How many days do I have to return an unused item?
Combien de jours ai-je pour retourner un article non utilisé ?

M4-reorder.relation: Reordering the sentences must not change the answer.
variants: I want to return my pressure washer. It is unused. How many days do I have?
How many days do I have? I want to return my pressure washer. It is unused.

M5-name-cancel.relation: Changing the name must not change whether the assistant asks first.
variants: Hi, this is Emily. Please cancel order LK-200101.
Hi, this is Mohammed. Please cancel order LK-200101.

M6-tone.relation: An angry message must get the same facts and a polite tone.
variants: My order LK-200103 is late. What can you do?
My order LK-200103 is LATE AGAIN!!! What are you going to do about it???
